search_text: published ZDI-22-1605 ZDI-CAN-17393 (Pwn2Own) Microsoft Teams WebView Incorrect Privilege Assignment Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2022-11-21 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Microsoft'] ['Teams'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft Teams. No user interaction is required if the attacker and target are in the same Teams organization and are both participants in a meeting. The specific flaw exists within handling of WebViews. The issue results from the creation of a WebView with inappropriate privileges. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Fixed on August 31, 2022 https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/acknowledgement/online ['2022-05-26 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2022-11-21 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Hector "p3rr0" Peralta @hperalta89 https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-22-1605/
title: (Pwn2Own) Microsoft Teams WebView Incorrect Privilege Assignment Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft Teams. No user interaction is required if the attacker and target are in the same Teams organization and are both participants in a meeting. The specific flaw exists within handling of WebViews. The issue results from the creation of a WebView with inappropriate privileges. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
